name: Elite Site Optimizer
summary: SEO platform with rank tracking, site crawling and analysis, competitor and backlink reports, spell-checking and an AI citation report, with a 14-day trial.
best_for: small businesses, freelancers and agencies that want rank tracking, site crawling and competitor reports in one SEO tool with a no-card trial
skip_if: you need a refund guarantee you can rely on, want published AI-citation quotas before you pay, or need a tool for more than five domains on a standard plan
honest_knock: The pricing FAQ promises a 30-day money-back guarantee, but the refund policy and the terms say payments are non-refundable, so we cannot tell you which one applies. The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency. The AI Citation Report's scope is not published, and usage overages are billed after the period and remain payable on cancellation.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · Basic billed monthly, shown with a dollar sign (the page names no ISO currency code): 1 domain, 1 user, 100 keywords, 1,000 crawl pages
pricing.notes: (monthly prices read 2026-11-05 on elitesiteoptimizer.com/pricing; annual totals read 15 October 2026) Elite Site Optimizer sells monthly or annual plans with limits on domains, users, campaigns and keywords. Basic costs $49 a month ($470 a year) for 1 domain, 1 user, 1 campaign, 100 keywords, 1,000 crawl pages and 3 competitors. Pro costs $69 a month ($662 a year) for 2 domains, 2 users, 5 campaigns, 750 keywords, 2,000 crawl pages and 5 competitors, and adds Zeroth Rank. Pro+ costs $119 a month ($1,142 a year) for 5 domains, 3 users, 20 campaigns, 2,500 keywords and 5,000 crawl pages. A separate AI Citation Report card costs $99 a month ($999 a year) and tracks where a brand appears in AI answers; the page does not say whether it is an add-on or what its quotas are. Enterprise is custom. The page shows dollar signs without naming the currency, and a 14-day free trial needs no card. Taxes are excluded under the general terms and usage overages are billed after the period.

exit_test.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 13 November 2026 the session tested Elite Site Optimizer on the free trial: domain verification in three steps, a site audit request, rank tracking, competitor and AI readiness pages, and the plan page. Verification took three steps. First the business email OTP, done by Daan at about 09:17. That gave temporary verification: the Keywords page said the domain is verified temporarily using business email and that a TXT record must be added to access all features, and Add Keywords and Add Bulk Keyword were grey. Then, at Daan request, our AI assistant added a TXT verification record at the root of the domain at the DNS host between 10:15 and 10:20, with a TTL of 3600. The token expires in 7 days and its value is not recorded here. The host panel reported that the record was not valid or conflicted with another record, but a DNS query to the name server showed the record, and it had been there since the first try. Submit in the tool then said the domain was already verified. After full verification the Keywords page still said This feature is available for our premium members only, and Add Keywords and Add Bulk Keyword stayed grey, so rank tracking is not part of the free trial. Competitor Ranking showed No Metric Data Available with a grey Competitor Settings button. AI Readiness has only a Run Report Now button, which was grey, and clicking it did nothing. The AI Add-ons tab was empty, and the Competitor Analysis tab next to Site Audit stays empty without a report. Site Audit, Run Report Now, offered only HARD RUN (it checks for new web pages and runs a complete report), with a Home Page section, and starts by itself after 60 seconds. The first attempt appeared to do nothing and the page stayed on No report available yet. The second attempt, with the section chosen, gave the notice that the report would be ready in about 7 hours, at 09:20. At 17:49, about 8.5 hours after the start, there was still no report and no notification apart from two Domain Added Successfully messages, so the promise was not met. The browser session had been logged out, and Daan logged in again before this check. Analysts needing market traffic data were not tested, as no traffic data part was viewed. The TXT record stays in the DNS of the tested domain until cleaned up. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Verification needs an email OTP and then a DNS TXT record, with only temporary access in between. Rank tracking is premium only, Competitor Settings and AI Readiness are grey, and the audit promised in about 7 hours had not arrived after about 8.5 hours.

sessions.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 13 November 2026 we tested Elite Site Optimizer on the free trial: domain verification, a site audit request, rank tracking, competitor and AI Readiness pages, and the plan page. We did not test checkout, support, export or any finished report.
findings: Verification took three steps: a business email code, then a temporary verification that said a DNS TXT record was needed, then the TXT record itself, which our AI assistant added at Daan's request. The token is valid for 7 days.

After full verification, keyword tracking still said 'This feature is available for our premium members only!' and Add Keywords and Add Bulk Keyword stayed grey. The pricing page of 7 November says the trial gives the complete platform free for 14 days, so rank tracking did not match that.
Competitor Settings and the AI Readiness Run Report Now button were grey, and the AI Add-ons tab was empty.

The site audit offered one option, HARD RUN. The first attempt seemed to do nothing. The second, at 09:20, promised a report in about 7 hours. At 17:49, about 8.5 hours later, there was no report and no notification, so no report content was tested.
Monthly plan prices we saw: Free $0, Basic $49, Pro $69, Premium $119. We did not open the yearly prices or checkout.
